dataset: Retallick-Townsley 2026 Supplementary Data 2 baseline and library
features: absolute allele-pair differences in ACGT 1-3-mer counts; train-only standardization
model: L2 logistic regression, lambda 0.1, 4000 fixed iterations, learning rate 0.05
target: author FDR <=0.05 versus nonsignificant assay call; not a functional vs nonfunctional truth label
caveats: Exploratory same-study holdout, no external donor or study validation.
Selected variants and binary statistical detection depend on assay power and selection; nonsignificant is not a biological negative.
This task is not disease prediction and cannot validate insomnia-frailty scores.
No AlphaGenome outputs or derivatives used.
